description: Core defaults, plus HTTP access for the Glances poller. The http scope cannot be narrowed to a host list: an endpoint is whatever address the user configures — a LAN IP, a hostname, a reverse-proxied domain, on any port — and Tauri evaluates this scope at build time with no runtime hook to tighten it once a server has been added. It still confines the plugin to http and https, so no file:// or custom scheme is reachable, and the poller is the only caller.
